## Change and validation

Describe the behavior and the checks performed.

## Rights and dependencies

- [ ] I identified original work, upstream imports/copied material and material AI assistance.
- [ ] I can accept [CLA v1](../CLA.md) for my original contribution; I will respond to the CLA check if requested. This checkbox is not a signature.
- [ ] New or changed dependencies, binaries, fonts or media have exact provenance, license evidence and a review in `docs/licensing/dependencies.json` where applicable.
- [ ] Notices and corresponding-source records match the actual shipped components, or the review explicitly blocks release pending resolution.
- [ ] I ran `python3 Tools/licensing/verify-rights.py` and read `RIGHTS.md`.

For upstream imports, list the repository, exact revisions, original authors
and licenses. A CLA signature does not grant rights in those upstream portions.
